                    ### Question
                    Phenylketonuria occurs as a consequence of the deficiency of phenylalanine hydroxylase and severely affects the central nervous system. Its mode of hereditary transmission is the following:

                    ### Options
                    opa. Autosomal and recessive transmission.
opb. Transmission linked to the X chromosome
opc. Autosomal and dominant transmission.
opd. It is transmitted by the mother, because the gene is in the mitochondrial chromosome.

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Phenylketonuria is inherited in an autosomal recessive manner due to the deficiency of phenylalanine hydroxylase. This condition severely affects the central nervous system. Evidence supports the association of phenylalanine hydroxylase with genes in eukaryotic cells and its role in dyslipidemias, reinforcing the autosomal inheritance pattern.
